[[File:Bolvan-Hija-ANH.jpg|thumb|250px|"Shocklock" ranging laser, bottom center]]
The '''"Shocklock" ranging laser''' was a system used aboard the [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial''-class Star Destroyers]] of the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]]. Its purpose was to feed both range and telemetry data to the targeting systems of the ship's heavy weapons, such as [[Turbolaser/Legends|turbolasers]]. It was developed by [[Borstel Galactic Defense/Legends|Borstel Galactic Defense]].
